title: Tunes with eighth notes
summary: Rhythms that repeat from bar to bar.

steps.title: Spot the pattern
text: In most real music a rhythm repeats from bar to bar. In the next two tunes, find the bars that share a rhythm.
Once you have the pattern, you only have to read the notes.

steps.title: In two
text: Bars 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 all have the same rhythm.

steps.title: In three
text: A quarter, two eighths and a quarter, again and again.
